text:
:= by
  obtain ⟨f_inv, f_inv_left, f_inv_right⟩ := IsIso.fintype f
  obtain ⟨g_inv, g_inv_left, g_inv_right⟩ := IsIso.fintype g
  constructor
  · rw [← f_inv_right, ← g_inv_right]
    apply (g ≫ f_inv) ≫ g_inv
    refine (assoc _ _ _) ▸ _
    exact (assoc _ _ _) ▸ g_inv_left
  · rw [← f_inv_left, ← g_inv_left]
    apply (f ≫ g_inv) ≫ f_inv
    refine (assoc _ _ _) ▸ _
    exact (assoc _ _ _) ▸ f_inv_right
